facts.event: Tris 天亮前照计划把水槽下的清洁用品篮挪到隔壁柜子里，自己折进腾出的柜格、关上门，蹲在里面等 Foxes 来开晨会。
facts.text: I go through the atrium to the dining room, and then, just as I planned, I pull the basket of cleaning products out from under the sink, slide it into the next cabinet over, on top of the dish towels, and then I fold myself into the space I left behind.

facts.event: Gretchen 拉开柜门盯着 Tris 看了几秒，抱起手臂只说一句“出来”；Tris 蜷久了腿麻，爬出来站直。
facts.text:
The cabinet opens. Gretchen looks at me for a few seconds, then crosses her arms.



“Out,” she says.



My legs are numb from being so curled up for so long.

facts.event: 被追问时 Tris 谎称两人昨晚在玩捉迷藏，Gretchen 反问“那你呢？卡住了？”；旁边那个总穿靴子、被叫作 Boots 的男孩端着脏杯子看她。
facts.text:
“We were playing hide-and-seek last night.”




“And you, what? Got stuck?”



The person Gretchen was talking to is a boy, a few years older than I am, the one they call Boots.

facts.event: Gretchen 笑说 Foxes 开会只是商量偷什么、派谁去偷、把消息分派出去，不让人旁听只因为嫌分心——Tris 由此认定清晨偷听不会有料。
facts.text: All we do is talk about what needs to be stolen and who’s going to steal it, and then allocate messages to be sent.”

facts.event: Tris 问 Foxes 选拔赛何时举行，Colin 说就在几周后；他随即直言她太瘦小，得先练出耐力、力气和自卫本事。
facts.text: It’s just . . . you have to get into shape,” he says. “You need good endurance and enough strength to lift heavy things.

facts.event: Tris 断定靠偷听永远拿不到真相，于是决定改走另一条路：让自己成为 Foxes 的一员。
facts.text:
So I’ll just have to become one of them.




We get off the train—always easier for me than getting on—close to Dauntless headquarters, according to the map I’ve now memorized.

facts.event: 水处理中心里 Jove 教 Tris 当“Step One”（搬混凝剂、倒进大罐、按绿键），Carr 则说每个无派系者都该能举起自己的体重，Tris 自认做不到。
facts.text: “Every factionless should be able to lift his or her own body weight,” Carr says. “Unless there’s some condition preventing them from doing so.”

facts.event: Weaver 带哨兵围住众人，指控 Jove 借“带新人”把守卫从拘留所抽走、配合当晚越狱（至少十人），并用枪抵住她胸骨。
facts.text: “At the detention facility—your factionless pals broke at least ten people out of their holding cells, and I know she’s got something to do with it.”

relations: Tris→Jove：Jove 是无派系者的带路人兼劳动督导，明说“Evelyn told me to keep an eye on you anyway”，替 Evelyn 盯着她。
Jove↔Evelyn：出勤安排与“看着 Tris”都是 Evelyn 的意思，Jove 听命于她。
Tris↔Colin / Rory：同批自称 faction failures 的新人，一起跑车、学生活技能；Colin 直言她“small. And weak.”。
Gretchen / Boots（Foxes）→Tris：把她当想入会的 stray，用入会资格吊着她，要她“凭本事进来”。
Weaver（Dauntless 哨兵）↔Jove：公开敌意，枪口抵胸骨（保险仍关着），并断言无派系者与越狱者是一伙。
Carr（Fixers，驻 Museum）↔Tris：当班师傅，只认章程，不信 Jove 的辩解。
numbers: “the fifth day”（她到 Rookery 后的第五天傍晚）
“one hundred”（她在 Rookery 数出的椅子数）
“three people in here a day”（水处理中心每天只需三人当班）
“at least ten people”（从拘留所被放走的人数）
“six weeks”（Colin 说练出力量至少要六周）
“A few weeks from now.”（Foxes 选拔赛的时间）
“one story over the street”（她悬在街面上方一层楼高）
“three buttons”（控制盘上绿、红、蓝三个按钮）
“short a crate today”（Weaver 扣下的一箱纸制品）
